# QR generator

`qrcode.js` is vendored unchanged from `qrcode-generator@2.0.4`,
`dist/qrcode.js`, published by Kazuhiko Arase under the MIT license.
The copyright and license notice are preserved at the top of the file.

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz

Hosting this locally keeps invitation codes away from third-party QR APIs/CDNs.
